newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso climbs 3,10 to 1,107.7 vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso climbs 3,10 to 1,107.7 vs dollar.

text.p: BOGOTA, July 22 Reuter - Colombia's peso clawed back 3,10 pesos to 1,107.7 against the dollar in see-saw trading, interbank dealers said.

Dealers said the peso was correcting after local press reports of a row between the country's Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo and President Ernesto Samper over fiscal management sent the peso tumbling Monday.
Dealers reported 446 trades worth an above average $223 million. The peso opened at 1,111.75 and traded between its intraday high of 1,107 and a low of 1,112.95.
